image_2 defines only the sanctuary environment: a quiet cove shoreline with gentle waves and Aida's crystal singing bowl. Do not use or invent characters from it.

The rose quartz pendant and its pink glow belong to Aida only.

Shot 1 — the ritual. Camera: a slow push-in from a wide of the quiet cove toward Aida seated beside the crystal bowl. Gentle waves roll onto the shore. She runs the wand softly around the bowl's rim and a low shimmering tone rises <sustained crystal-bowl tone>; the cove seems to quiet around it — the water calms, the air stills. She closes her eyes. Her rose quartz pendant begins to glow, and soft pink light rises across her face from below, growing steadily stronger. Hold on her still, pink-lit face for two full seconds. End state: Aida perfectly still with eyes closed, her face lit in rose-pink, the bowl's tone sustained — a describable frame.

promptText:
image_1 defines exactly one Fuzzby: identity, proportions, fur, spectacles, bulbous tan nose and translucent wings. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background. Do not add pollen sacks, bags, harnesses or body-mounted loads.
image_2 defines exactly one Zenny: identity, slender smaller proportions, fur, round glasses, long eyelashes, blush cheeks and translucent wings. Refer to it strictly. Do not use its pose or background. Do not add pollen sacks, bags or harnesses.
image_3 defines only the environment, bee-height scale, plant materials, light direction and atmospheric depth. Do not use or invent characters from it.
Fuzzby is clearly the larger bee and stages frame-left; Zenny is smaller and stages frame-right. Exactly one Fuzzby and one Zenny throughout; no duplicates, no blended identities.
Feature-quality stylized 3D CGI: tactile fur with individual strands, translucent wings, glossy eyes with catchlights, subsurface scattering, warm luminous daylight, shallow depth of field.
Dialogue language: English. Fuzzby speaks in manic staccato bursts with total, unearned conviction — never distressed, even mid-disaster. Zenny is silent throughout and listens with her mouth naturally closed. No narrator, no crowd, no added speech.

Shot 1 — the chase. Handheld bee-height pursuit travelling deep into the flower corridor: the camera chases Fuzzby from behind and slightly beside him, always a beat late. The corridor recedes ahead and the world passes at three speeds — foreground stems rip past the lens in hard blur, midground flowers slide by, distant canopy drifts slowly. Fuzzby covers real ground: he passes a tall pink flower, ducks beneath an arching stem, threads a narrow gap between two blooms, each landmark passing the camera and vanishing behind it. He repeatedly pulls ahead and shrinks toward mid-frame, then the camera surges and he swells large again; he drifts toward the frame edge and the camera swings to recover him. He never sits still in the centre of frame. His round body tilts hard left then careens hard right on every correction, wings buzzing at frantic speed, altitude bobbing, chest leading each turn. Foreground stems occasionally wipe fully across the lens, hiding him for an instant before he reappears further down the corridor. Zenny travels the same corridor frame-right on a smooth unhurried line, holding her position relative to him with no effort. Fuzzby sings at a manic staccato pace: {BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY} <wings buzzing loudly, petals swishing, air rushing> End state: Fuzzby deep in the corridor at full speed, a dense cluster of flowers directly in his path and no room left to correct.

Shot 2 — the escalation. Three separate, clearly readable contacts, each worse than the last. His shoulder clips the first flower: he wobbles and spins once, correcting badly, pollen puffing. He clips the second harder: the spin doubles, wings stuttering as he fights it. He clips the third: control is gone entirely and he tumbles sideways. Each impact is distinct and separated, never blurred together, and each spin is visibly larger than the one before. He slams shoulder-first onto a broad springy green leaf. The leaf takes his full weight and bends deep, curving down like a loaded spring, its edges quivering under the strain, Fuzzby pressed helplessly into the bend. <three distinct impacts, comedic thud> End state: held on the leaf at maximum load, bent as far as it will go, Fuzzby motionless against it for a beat.

Shot 3 — the impossible recovery. The leaf snaps back and fires him high into the golden air. Fuzzby performs a perfect accidental gymnastics move: a double backward tuck with a triple twist. His body pulls tight into a compact ball, wings folded in, rotating backward twice while spinning three times around his own vertical axis, golden pollen spiralling off him in a helix. He opens out cleanly at the top of the arc, arms and wings spreading wide. The camera tracks the full aerial so every rotation reads clearly. <rushing air, wing snap> End state: Fuzzby at the top of his arc, fully opened out, beginning to fall.

Shot 4 — the button. He drops and sets down in a superhero landing, frame-left: one leg extended, one knee bent, arms wide, head lowered, pollen bursting outward around him. He stays down for a beat. Then his head snaps up and his eyes dart left, then right. He looks down at his own body and pats his chest, checking he is intact. The realisation lands: he is completely fine. Only then does his chest inflate, his chin lift and his arms spread wide with total conviction, as if he meant every second of it. He declares, flat and certain, no rush: {Nailed it.} The pose holds for a full beat after the line ends. Cut to Zenny, frame-right: almost completely motionless, watching him, her flat unbothered expression held long — she does not react, and the length of her stillness is the joke. Hold on her face. End state: Fuzzby posed and pollen-dusted frame-left, Zenny composed and silent frame-right.

No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.

Shot 1 — the transfer. Bee-height shot, both bees in frame. Fuzzby spots a flower off to one side and launches at it far too hard — wings hammering, body pitching forward, altitude bobbing wildly as he overcorrects. He overshoots it, has to swing back, and arrives at the bloom faster than he can stop, burying his face into its centre with a jolt that shakes the whole stem. His round body, kicking back legs and buzzing wings stay entirely outside the petals, clearly visible throughout. The petals compress around his face and the flower's stamens press hard against his upper lip, visibly loading it with thick bright yellow pollen. Keep the source flower fully in frame so the transfer is unmistakable. Zenny holds frame-right, completely still, her face clean, watching without moving. Cut before he withdraws. <wings hammering, stem jolt, soft petal compression> End state: Fuzzby's face still buried in the flower, body outside and legs kicking, stem still swaying, the transfer complete but unseen.

Shot 2 — the reveal. Close-up on Fuzzby as he pulls slowly back from the flower. Two boldly curled yellow pollen marks now sit on his upper lip, forming a ridiculous handlebar moustache. His eyes behind his spectacles show zero awareness that anything is wrong. He lifts his chin and turns his face toward Zenny, presenting it with growing pride — a flicker of needing approval underneath the confidence. He asks, hopeful and completely sincere: {Do I look official?} He holds the presented pose for a full beat after the line ends. End state: Fuzzby frame-left, chin raised, moustache fully legible, waiting.

Shot 3 — the verdict. Cut to Zenny, frame-right, medium shot, almost completely motionless. Her face is entirely clean — she has no moustache and no pollen on her at all. Her eyes track deliberately down to his moustache, examine it for a beat, then travel slowly back up to meet his. One corner of her mouth tightens almost imperceptibly — she is fighting it and nearly losing. She delivers slowly, warmly, almost affectionately: {Yes Fuzzby. Officially nuts!} Hold on her clean face for a full beat after she finishes speaking. Then cut wide: both bees together in warm light, the moustache on Fuzzby alone, Zenny's face clean and softening. End state: Fuzzby proudly moustachioed frame-left, Zenny clean-faced and quietly smiling frame-right — harvest this frame as the opening of the next shot.

Shot 1 — the world turns first. Medium-wide framing both bees in the warm aftermath, golden pollen suspended around them. A distant deep thunder rumble rolls in <distant thunder> and the suspended pollen trembles in response. The change begins in the environment before either character reacts, in this order: the warm god-rays thin and fade; the sky beyond the canopy greys over; colour drains from the pinks and oranges toward blue-grey; a first wind moves through the corridor so every stem and leaf sways and the loose pollen streams sideways off the flowers; the wide-open flowers begin to furl and droop, closing against the coming rain. Only after the world has visibly turned do Fuzzby's wings hitch twice out of rhythm; his hover tilts sideways and drops before he catches himself, forces his posture upright and exhales with performed calm, breezy and unconvincing: {…okay that sounded dramatic.} End state: the corridor half-cooled and moving in the wind, flowers half-closed, Fuzzby frame-left pretending nothing happened, Zenny frame-right unmoved and clean.

Shot 2 — the read. Cut to Zenny, frame-right, close, the camera pushing in on her very slowly. Her hovering quiets almost to stillness while the wind keeps the petals behind her moving. She tilts her gaze slowly upward through a gap between the closing petals toward the darkening sky and genuinely listens — a real beat of attention, not a glance. Distant lightning flickers once, lighting the cloud from inside <a longer thunder roll, nearer than before>. Her faint amusement leaves her face by degrees, not all at once, settling into quiet certainty. She says quietly, unhurried, without drama: {A storm's coming.} Hold her stillness and her upward gaze for a full beat after the line ends. End state: Zenny still and looking up, face clean and serious, the corridor fully storm-lit and cold behind her.

Shot 3 — the overcorrection. Cut back to Fuzzby. He straightens too fast, heroic before the moment has settled, and declares at full volume: {Good thing I work well under pressure!} He launches forward on a fast, perfectly straight line, the camera tracking him from the side as stems and leaves whip past between him and the lens, and drives face-first into a large flower directly ahead. Its petals compress fully around his head and grip; his body, legs and wings stay entirely outside, kicking in the gusting wind. <close thunder cracks overhead> End state: Fuzzby's head buried in the flower, legs kicking, the whole corridor swaying.

Shot 4 — the witness. Cut to Zenny hovering beside the flower containing his head — the flower and his kicking legs frame-left, Zenny frame-right. Her expression moves from patient concern into fond resignation — a small breath out, a slight tilt of the head, the worry staying underneath. Nothing else acts; only the wind keeps the corridor moving. Hold this final image for a long beat, at least two full seconds. Slow fade to black. End state: Fuzzby's head inside the flower frame-left with legs kicking, Zenny calm and clean beside him frame-right, the corridor cold and moving in the wind.

No music. No subtitles, captions or on-screen text. No watermark. No extra characters.
